messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.37-11
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.37-11) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org) and will be on CRAN shortly.

See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a list of changes.  There are
no major changes...just a small number of bug fixes.

As always, I'd appreciate hearing any suggestions or comments or
complaints.

Karl Broman
